info.title: altatui
info.description: CodeAlta TUI: a keyboard-first terminal UI for agentic AI coding on your local projects, with durable sessions, model providers, MCP servers, skills and plugins. Start it with the altatui command.

options.name: --no-plugins
options.description:
Disable plugin discovery, build, and load for this
process

options.name: --plugin-safe-mode
options.description: Disable plugin discovery, build, and load for this

options.name: --plugins-status
options.description:
Print plugin discovery/config status and exit
without starting the TUI

options.name: --plugins-wait-for-enter
options.description:
Wait for Enter after source plugin live progress
finishes

options.name: --dev
options.description:
Run as the developer instance: beside the normal
one on the same ~/.alta profile, with its own
sessions, view state, logs and lock under ~/.
alta/dev

options.name: --version
options.description: Show the version of this command
